title: durabilityframe
summary: The HUD durability alert ('armor guy' under the minimap, 8 together-shown body pieces + 3 show-separate weapon/shield/ranged pieces off the UI-Durability-Icons atlas, yellow damaged / red broken) has no MSUI counterpart. MSUI does track durability elsewhere - paper-doll broken tinting (PaperDollUiLaw.IsBroken in Program.CharacterPage.cs), vendor repair (Program.Vendor.Repair.cs), DurabilityTables.cs - but no on-screen alert frame exists.

openItems.text: Entire DurabilityFrame surface: inventory-alert status computation (damaged <20% / broken), the 11-region atlas figure, show/hide law, and minimap-relative managed seating
